Presenting HUM LOOTNE AAYE HAIN FULL VIDEO SONG from SHANKAR SHAMBHU movie starring Feroz Khan, Sulakhshana Pandit, Jagdeep, Ajit, Vinod Khanna, Anwar Hussan, Pradeep Kumar, Lalita Pawar in lead roles, released in 1976. The song is sung by Jani Babu, Aziz Nazan and music is given by Kalyanji-Anandji, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: HUM LOOTNE AAYE HAIN
Singer: JANI BABU, AZIZ NAZAN
Music Director: KALYANJI–ANANDJI
Lyricist: SAHIR LUDHIANVI
